boundaries.input: native synthetic RGGB linear spectral field; independent Gaussian sample noise
boundaries.oracle: known integer translation used in labelled control only; included in training, excluded from validation selection and main scores
boundaries.gradient: one-step truncated BPTT; burn-in without gradient, then visible-frame supervision
boundaries.normalization: one canonical adaptive catalogue training calibration; copied to every arm
boundaries.capacity_controls: E/F inject current measurement into same additional branch; old historical gates and graph retained
boundaries.parameter_budget: C/D/E/F match exactly; A/B lack content branch; report active and total counts
boundaries.units: packed cell = two sensor pixels; no RGB reconstruction or teacher
boundaries.checkpoint_selection: minimum ordinary-condition validation early error; final test used once
boundaries.generalization: synthetic mechanism probe; no camera, VLA, sensor-transfer or robot acceptance

runs.rss_scope: process lifetime maximum; may include previously evaluated arms

static_weak.error_unit: packed CFA grid cells (one cell = two physical sensor pixels)
